name: Love lock customizable with your initials

captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two separate parts: a thick, heart-shaped padlock body and a matching U-shaped locking shackle. The heart body features two rectangular vertical channels passing through its lobes to receive the shackle. The shackle has notched inner ends designed to snap into a one-way internal locking mechanism inside the heart.
captions.instruction: Create a customizable, 3D-printable one-time padlock with a heart-shaped body and a matching locking shackle. The design should include parameters for customizable front text, text size, font, and positioning, with internal locking channels built into the heart body.
captions.factory: The design is built using 2D polygons extruded into 3D shapes. The heart body ('herz') is extruded from a custom polygon and hollowed out using 'difference' with internal locking geometries ('luecke' and 'klick') defined by separate extruded polygons. The shackle ('buegel') is extruded from a detailed U-shaped polygon with notched tips. Customizable text is applied to the front face of the heart using the 'write' library with adjustable position and font parameters.
